name: Edilizia Acrobatica
note: Back Partner of Torino FC (club partner page and 2026-27 kit announcements). The shirt brand is 'Acrobatica', the consumer-facing name of the EdiliziAcrobatica group; the club's partner page lists 'Edilizia Acrobatica - Back Partner'. Chain: EdiliziAcrobatica S.p.A. (listed, Euronext Growth Milan/Paris) -> Arim Holding Sarl (73.3%, April 2023 filing). No state found in the chain so far; the ultimate holders of Arim Holding Sarl are not established by an open source (la Repubblica, 28 Sept 2026, says CEO Anna Marras controls 72.6% through Arim Holding Sarl, but the article is paywalled).
